scores.Biological Plausibility_reason: The FXYD6–Na+/K+-ATPase and Cnr1/CCK-interneuron foundations are defensible, and the proposed cytoskeletal and morphological modulation is coherent. However, the direct pump-to-input-resistance claim is electrophysiologically simplified, while the Coro6 and Ctxn1 functional assignments rely on uncertain extrapolation.
scores.Mechanistic Synthesis_reason: The response integrates Cnr1-defined interneuron identity, Coro6-dependent membrane organization, and Ctxn1/Pcdh8-associated morphology into an FXYD6–pump explanation of input resistance. The Ctxn1/Pcdh8-to-morphology transition and the precise route by which pump activity changes input resistance remain insufficiently resolved. No mechanistic ceiling was applied because an explicit, coherent focus-feature-to-target mechanism includes the relevant contextual features.
